description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.19.2 is a bug-fix release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.1.
New
- Find in terminal. Press ⌘F (Ctrl+Shift+F on Windows and Linux) in a chat pane, terminal, mission slot or mission drawer terminal to search its scrollback. Matches are highlighted, Enter and ⇧Enter step through them, and Esc puts the terminal back where it was. On Windows and Linux, Ctrl+F still reaches the shell. The shortcut can be changed in Settings → Keyboard shortcuts. (#897)
- New chat is now New tab. The launcher starts chats, terminals and missions, so the sidebar row, the Recents menu, the command palette and Settings → Shortcuts now call it New tab. While the launcher page shows, a dashed New tab row marks it under its project or Recents, and the page closes with its ×, the row's × or ⌘W. (#1117)
- Cloud group in Settings. Account and Remote access move into their own Cloud group, between Integrations and System. (#1101)
Bug fixes
- Switching chats on a remote computer no longer replays the whole screen. Going back to a remote chat showed a burst of page-flipping scroll while the agent reprinted its history. Chats in open tabs now stay attached, and a repaint that does arrive is drawn once. (#1025)
- Codex mission slots resume after a restart. A Codex SessionEnd for a conversation the slot wasn't tracking could replace its saved conversation, and Resume slot then failed with "No saved session found". (#1109)
- Mission messages are no longer held after a confirmed notice. A Claude Code member could stay Unsent long after its previous inbox notice was confirmed, until its pane redrew. (#1125)
- Multi-paragraph messages from Windows mission members arrive whole. runner msg post from a Codex member on Windows stored only the first paragraph. (#1107)
- runner mission answer refuses a question that isn't pending. An answer to an unknown or already-answered ID now fails and lists the pending IDs, instead of being dropped silently. The member's ask_human event ID is accepted too. (#1121)
- Two Runner builds no longer replace each other's daemon. A Runner build that finds another build using the same data now asks you to quit that one first, instead of stopping its runnerd and hanging up its sessions. (#1116)
- Agent usage survives a runnerd restart. After Quit & Stop Sessions, an update or a reboot, the footer usage pill and the Usage popover keep the last numbers instead of showing Checking… until the next fetch. (#984)
- The side panel stays open in a chat and terminal split. Focusing the terminal pane no longer closes the chat's side panel. (#1111)
- Remote Roles and Crews pages are opaque. With the Glass window material, a remote computer's Roles and Crews pages showed the desktop through them. (#1132)
- Paired phones show as phones in Remote access. They used to appear as unknown computers named by their fingerprint. (#1122)
- The model chooser keeps its highlight in view while you move through a long list with the arrow keys. (#1066)
- Side panel resize handles sit on the panel border, so the edge no longer jumps when a drag starts. (#1123)
